name: Scout Riell
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Scout Riell watches Westfall from the watchtower roof. She serves the People's Militia, tracking the Defias Brotherhood and calling on travelers to bring back the outlaws' red silk bandanas.

sections.title: Eyes Over Westfall
sections.body: Scout Riell watches the plains from the stone tower at Sentinel Hill, where banditry and harvest golems threaten Westfall. Stormwind's royal army is absent, and the crown refuses aid, leaving the People's Militia to defend the region. From the tower roof, Riell tracks the Defias Brotherhood's movements and gathers proof of their crimes. She calls on passing travelers to take red silk bandanas from the bandits.

faq.q: Where can I find Scout Riell?
faq.answer: Scout Riell watches from the roof of the stone watchtower at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Climb the stairs to reach her.

faq.q: What does Scout Riell ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Riell asks travelers to collect red silk bandanas from Defias cutpurses, highwaymen, and smugglers in Westfall and the Deadmines. The bandanas prove the outlaws have been slain.

faq.q: Why does Riell collect red silk bandanas?
faq.answer: The red silk bandana marks a member of the Defias Brotherhood. Collecting them gives proof that the bandits terrorizing Westfall's homesteads are being reduced and takes away their unifying symbol.

faq.q: Who does Scout Riell work for?
faq.answer: Riell serves the People's Militia, a volunteer defense force Gryan Stoutmantle formed to protect Westfall after the House of Nobles in Stormwind turned a blind eye to the province's plight.

angles.text: For Alliance champions, Scout Riell shows Westfall's grim reality: its abandoned people must hire mercenaries to fight the rising threat of the Defias Brotherhood.
Tailors may recognize that the Defias' signature red masks are made from genuine silk, an expensive fabric for common rural highwaymen.
